name: clear-button
description: An icon-only button inside another component that clears or removes its value, such as the remove control on a tag or the clear control in a search field.

staticColor.description: Static color must not be set for the default version of this component. React Spectrum sets it on a selected, emphasized tag, whose background is accent.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Round, transparent hit area that holds the cross. It has no fill in any state.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Cross mark that clears or removes the value.

anatomy.name: focus-indicator
anatomy.description: Outline drawn inside the container for keyboard focus.

anatomyReview.notes: From React Spectrum ClearButton.tsx (round, transparent, inset focus ring) and SWC 1st-gen sp-clear-button. Same parts as close-button: the cross is the icon. Figma draws no clear button, only a bare cross glyph inside the tag.
